Environment concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a wide establishing view of the edge of a pale peach desert plain where the ground is coming apart and falling upward, seen from the plain at mid-morning. In the foreground the ground is cracked; further out great slabs of the plain tilt up out of it, then hang a few metres in the air, then float higher and higher over a sea of white cloud below a rose cliff, each slab still carrying its own bone-white needle spires, hoodoos and a little stone arch, roots and threads of red rock trailing beneath them, loose pebbles drifting up; far off, cliff-top monasteries and an island church float in the haze, and a great bird circles. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade glass fluid backpack stands on the first tilted slab for scale.
